candidates.video_title: 3 Planets Retrograde Right Now — One Changes Everything
candidates.video_description: Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune are all retrograde simultaneously. Here's what that triple reversal actually means for you right now, and which one demands your attention most.
candidates.script: Three planets are retrograde right now — and most people have no idea what that combination actually does. Saturn is retrograde in Aries, forcing you to rebuild the structures you thought were solid. Uranus is retrograde in Gemini, quietly rewiring how you think and communicate. Neptune is retrograde in Aries — right alongside Saturn — blurring the line between discipline and illusion. In astrology, when these three stack up, nothing is what it appears. So what's quietly unraveling in your life right now?

candidates.topic: Saturn Conjunct Neptune in Aries — Retrograde Together
candidates.teaser: Two slow-moving giants are sitting almost on top of each other in the same sign right now — and both are moving backward.
candidates.video_title: Saturn & Neptune Both Retrograde in Aries — What's Real?
candidates.video_description: Saturn at 8.5° and Neptune at 1.8° are both retrograde in Aries simultaneously. This rare overlap in astrology is said to blur discipline with delusion — here's what to watch for.
candidates.script: Saturn and Neptune are both retrograde in Aries right now — and in astrology, that combination is genuinely rare. Saturn sits at 8.5 degrees, Neptune at 1.8, both moving backward through the same fire sign simultaneously. Traditional astrology calls this a tension between reality and illusion — the structures you're trying to build keep dissolving, and the dreams you're chasing keep hitting walls. The question isn't which one wins. It's whether you can even tell them apart right now.

candidates.topic: Waxing Crescent Moon in Capricorn — Building Under Pressure
candidates.teaser: The Moon is in Capricorn right now, and in astrology this crescent phase has one very specific warning attached to it.
candidates.video_title: Waxing Crescent in Capricorn — The Moon's Hidden Demand
candidates.video_description: The Moon is currently a Waxing Crescent at 23° Capricorn. In astrology, this phase combined with Capricorn's energy creates a narrow window for deliberate, disciplined action — but most people miss it.
candidates.script: If you've been waiting for the right moment to make your move — the Moon is literally in Capricorn right now at 23 degrees, and it's a Waxing Crescent. In astrology, this is the phase of intentional building, and Capricorn amplifies that with cold, strategic focus. But here's the tension: the Sun is deep in Scorpio season, pulling you inward while the Moon in Capricorn demands output. One wants transformation. The other wants results. Which one are you actually listening to?

candidates.topic: Mars Conjunct Jupiter in Leo — What It Actually Amplifies
candidates.teaser: Mars and Jupiter are sitting at almost the exact same degree in Leo right now — and in astrology, this pairing has a very specific reputation.
candidates.video_title: Mars & Jupiter at 25° Leo — The Amplification Warning
candidates.video_description: Mars at 25.2° and Jupiter at 25.8° Leo are nearly exact conjuncts right now. Astrologers describe this as one of the most amplifying alignments in the zodiac — for better or worse.
candidates.script: Mars and Jupiter are at almost the exact same degree in Leo right now — 25.2 and 25.8 — and in astrology, this conjunction is described as a volume dial turned all the way up. Leo already craves recognition and bold action. Jupiter expands everything it touches. Mars adds fire and urgency. But here's what astrologers warn about: this alignment doesn't just amplify ambition — it amplifies whatever you're already running on. So if that energy is fear or ego, it gets louder too. What are you actually feeding right now?

candidates.topic: The Astrological 5th House — Creativity, Romance, Risk
candidates.teaser: There's one house in your birth chart that rules romance, creativity, AND gambling — and most people have never looked at it closely.
candidates.video_title: The 5th House — Where Astrology Hides Your True Joy
candidates.video_description: The 5th house in astrology governs creative self-expression, romantic attraction, children, and risk-taking. What's placed here — and what sign rules it — reveals where your soul comes alive.
candidates.script: There's a house in your birth chart that rules three things most people think have nothing in common — romance, creativity, and gambling. It's the 5th house, and in traditional astrology it's where your capacity for pure joy lives. The sign on the cusp of your 5th house shapes how you love, what you create, and what risks actually excite you. Leo naturally rules this house, which is why astrologers link it to self-expression and performance. But whatever sign sits there for you? That's the truest version of what makes you feel alive.
